_meta.title: Cummins India — FY25 actuals (market anchors)
_meta.secondarySourceUrl: Landscape/Cummins-India/Signed SE Intimation Combined Investor PPT Feb 17 2025.pdf
_meta.note: Cummins India reports only TWO segments for CODM purposes — Engines and Lubes. Power Gen revenue is NOT separately disclosed. Volume / output figures from MD&A are rounded / qualitative ('25,000+').

rows.label: Total revenue (standalone)
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.186 (Standalone P&L — Revenue from operations)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹8,958.60 Cr. +15.4% YoY. Consolidated Engines segment ₹10,219.24 Cr (p.339).

rows.label: EBITDA (standalone, computed)
rows.source: Computed: PBT ₹2,496.14 Cr + D&A ₹182.90 Cr + Finance costs ₹15.12 Cr (AR p.186)
rows.notes: Computed from P&L line items. EBITDA margin ~26.1%. Cummins does not disclose EBITDA as a headline metric.

rows.label: Net profit (standalone)
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.186 (Profit after tax)

rows.label: Power Gen segment revenue
rows.notes: Cummins segment note (p.339) reports only Engines + Lubes — no Power Gen / Industrial / Distribution split. Needs triangulation via unit volume × realization.

rows.label: Engines segment revenue (consolidated)
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.339 (Note 44 Segment information — consolidated)
rows.notes: Engines segment incl. PowerGen + Industrial + Distribution + Exports. Lubes JV (Valvoline Cummins) sales ₹2,352 Cr is equity-accounted separately.

rows.label: Industrial segment revenue
rows.notes: Not separated in segment reporting. Narrative: strong growth in Rail DETCs + HLCs + Defence + Marine.

rows.label: Distribution Business Unit (DBU) revenue
rows.notes: DBU includes PMS + RAS + OptiNAS+ + DGBLUE + aftermarket. 61% YoY growth with one construction-equip OEM (AR p.51).

rows.label: Water Management revenue
rows.source: Not applicable — Cummins has no WMS business
rows.notes: Cummins India does not operate in water / pumps. Entry kept for schema consistency.

rows.label: Revenue outside India
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.225 (Disaggregated revenue — Location)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹1,552.94 Cr. Driven by HHP PowerGen to NACA + LHP products to LatAm / Europe / ME. 17.1% of standalone revenue.

rows.label: Export revenue
rows.notes: Same as 'Outside India' location. Includes inter-company sales to Cummins group (Cummins Ltd UK: ₹1,059 Cr per RPT p.43).

rows.label: Gensets sold (FY25)
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.15 (Power generation — FY24-25 highlights)
rows.notes: Reported as '25,000+ Generator sets sold'. Rounded disclosure — not an exact figure. Also '7,000+ MW delivered' on same page.

rows.label: Avg realization per unit (implied)
rows.notes: Numerator (Power Gen revenue) is not disclosed. Denominator (25,000+ units) is rounded.

rows.label: CPCB IV+ gensets delivered FY25
rows.notes: '23,000+ CPCB IV+ gensets' — strong uptake in Delhi NCR per MD&A. Cummins claims first-mover advantage.

rows.label: GOEM dealer network
rows.source: Cummins AR FY24-25, p.53 (Achievements — Power Generation)

rows.label: CPCB IV+ share of Power Gen revenue
rows.notes: Not disclosed. Triangulation: 23,000 of 25,000 units = 92% by volume, but mix / price effects unknown.
